---
description: Prepare pr.
agent: agent
argument-hint: "Target branch and work item; prepare a preview, do not publish yet"
---


Read the approved diff and available check/review evidence. Verify the changed-file scope and work item criteria.
Prepare a Conventional Commit-compatible PR title and sections: Summary, Changes, Testing, Architecture/ADR impact, Security impact, Documentation, Risks, UI verification and Related work item.
Mark unrun or blocked checks honestly. Reference partial items without automatic closing; use closing keywords only for complete delivery.
Do not stage, commit, push, publish a PR, assign reviewers, merge or close an issue. These require separate explicit approval.
